text:
Tanvi (partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a lightweight weekly cadence for SI co-sell lead orchestration across cloud marketplace + hardware partners. Goal: reduce duplicate outreach, speed claim turnaround, and make account mapping deterministic.
Jake (sales): 👍 What cadence are you thinking? weekly 30m? who needs to attend?
Tanvi (partnerships): Weekly 20m standup on Tue 10am PT (pilot 4 weeks). Required: partner lead, SI AE, partner ops rep. Optional: revops + solutions for high-touch deals. We’ll keep an overlap table and a single source-of-truth tag in SFDC.
Maria (revops): Addendum: create a "symphony_lead" custom checkbox + a lead_source picklist value (partner_marketplace / partner_hw / si_direct). That'll let us surface dupes in reports.
Sam (solutions): Edge cases: multi-region accounts owned by different AEs — propose rule: if account.country_count > 1, create sub-claim in incite and assign to regional AE, but mark global SI lead as primary. Thoughts?
Tanvi (partnerships): Good call. Proposed rules of engagement (draft):
- First-touch: partner intake form -> partner-claims triage bot.
- 24h claim window: if no AE claim, partnerships assigns provisional holder.
- Strict single-claim per account per partner type (cloud/hw/si) except explicit carveouts.
- Double-claim resolution: escalate to regional SDR/AE manager within 48h.
Jake (sales): That 24h window might be tight for enterprise. Can we make it 48h for >$250k ARR?
Tanvi (partnerships): Yes — updated rule: 48h for deals with est ACV >= 250k. I'll add thresholds to the intake form.
Maria (revops): I'll add the automation: intake -> check SFDC for existing partner_claim tag; if found, post a @channel alert to #partnerships-claims with a short claim diff. Also add a report for weekly cadence.
Sam (solutions): For hardware partners we also need an installed-base flag. Some HW-driven opportunities are only valid if the customer has the appliance. Can we add a boolean on intake?
Tanvi (partnerships): Added to the form: "installed_base_confirmed" boolean. If false for HW partner claims, route to solutions for validation before AE claim window starts.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: partner-claims-bot v0.3 will create claims and post to #partnerships-claims. Deploy ETA Thu 6pm PT. See: https://confluence.redwood/partner-claims-runbook
Jake (sales): Love it. For marketplace led deals, how do we map accounts that come in via vendor marketplace vs direct SI intro?
Tanvi (partnerships): Mapping rule (draft):
- If lead.source == marketplace AND partner == cloud_vendor, tag as "marketplace_origin" and assign to marketplace specialist team.
- If SI provides intro and partner confirms, tag as "si_origin" and follow SI claim flow.
- If both apply, precedence: si_origin > marketplace_origin (SI verified intro wins).
Maria (revops): I'll implement precedence logic in the triage lambda. Example pseudo: ```if si_verified: assign(si_owner) elif marketplace_lead: assign(marketplace_owner) else: assign(default_partner_owner)```
Sam (solutions): Can we add a short checklist to the intake form for joint-announcement readiness? e.g., NDA status, approved press copy, legal contact.
Tanvi (partnerships): Yes — added a checklist. We'll only move to "joint-announcement" pipeline stage if all ticked.
Jake (sales): I can volunteer to run the first two cadences (Tue 10am PT) with Maria.
Maria (revops): I'll prepare the weekly report and the initial SFDC fields by EOD Wed.
Tanvi (partnerships): Thanks — I'll publish the pilot runbook and update the partner onboarding playbook. If folks agree, we'll start next Tue. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're in.
Sam (solutions): :thumbsup:
Jake (sales): :thumbsup:
Maria (revops): :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly cadence reminder posted to #partnerships at Tue 9:45am PT starting next week.
